 Job Description: 
 MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT:

 USSTRATCOM is a Combatant Command responsible for strategic deterrence, nuclear operations, and enterprise IT services essential to national security. It oversees Nuclear Command, Control, and Communications (NC3), Joint Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (JEMSO), Global Strike, and Missile Threat Assessments, working closely with other Combatant Commands, Services, and defense agencies. SCITLS will be a key component that will ensure mission success and the safety of the U.S. and its allies by providing 24/7 IT services and network support for NIPRNet, SIPRNet, JWICS, and SAP/SAR environments.

 You will play a crucial role in providing support in the following areas:
  
 Managing, automating, and securing IT infrastructure that supports mission‑critical RBS platforms and DevOps pipelines across USSTRATCOM environments.
 Designing, deploying, and maintaining RBS engineering environments, including automation workflows, system integrations, and service reliability functions.
 Supporting end‑to‑end system reliability engineering (SRE) processes, ensuring uptime, performance, monitoring, and rapid failure recovery for RBS applications and services.
 Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions (Red Hat AAP, GitOps) to support standardized, repeatable automation across RBS and DevOps ecosystems.
 Building, maintaining, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitLab, GitLab Runners, Git) to enable fast, reliable, and secure delivery of RBS application updates.
 Supporting multi‑platform infrastructure including  RHEL, SUSE, VmWare, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  Deploying and supporting containerized and orchestrated workloads using Docker and Kubernetes for RBS workflows and service delivery.
 Developing and maintaining RBS system documentation, configuration standards, automation scripts, and operational runbooks.
 Troubleshooting RBS‑related incidents, performing root‑cause analysis, and implementing long‑term improvements to system resilience.
 Support critical customer tools including Nexus, Gitlab, Mattermost, Traefik, KeyCloak, Elastic, Grafana, Jira, Confluence, BitBucket, and Sonatype SAGE.
 Collaborating closely with RBS program teams, cybersecurity, software developers, and RBS Customers to ensure engineering outputs align with business and mission priorities.
 
 WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED 
 Education: Technical Training, Certification(s), or Degree
 Experience: 8+ years of DevOps engineering, system administration, cloud engineering, or RBS‑aligned systems support
 Required Certifications: ITIL Foundations v4/v5 Certificate and DoW 8140 Certification within 9 Months
 Clearance : Must have a current/active Top Secret clearance with the ability to obtain TS/SCI
 Location: Offutt AFB, NE
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience supporting RBS environments, including system workflows, reliability engineering, process automation, and platform integration.
 Strong expertise in Linux (Ubuntu, RHEL) and VMware.
 Proficiency with Rancher, RKE2 .
  Hands‑on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Git, GitLab, Jira, and Confluence.
  Experience designing and supporting CI/CD automation for complex, multi‑team engineering programs.
 Strong troubleshooting capability across infrastructure, networks, cloud services, and automation toolchains.
  Ability to collaborate with RBS program managers, application teams, and mission stakeholders to ensure operational reliability.
  Demonstrated ability to write clear documentation, scripts, SOPs, and system diagrams.
 
 GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:
 401K with company match
 Comprehensive health and wellness packages
 Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
 Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications •
 Cutting-edge technology you can learn from
 Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holiday.
 
 #SCITLS

 
 
The likely salary range for this position is $112,840 - $126,500. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

40

 Total Rewards at GDIT: 
Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.  
  

 Our Identity Verification Process: 
As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during virtual interviews. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. By proceeding, you authorize the collection, processing, and use of your biometric data for identity verification and security purposes.  
  
 About Our Work: 
We are GDIT. A global technology and professional services company that delivers technology solutions and mission services to every major agency across the U.S. government, defense and intelligence community. Our 26,000 experts extract the power of technology to create immediate value and deliver solutions at the edge of innovation. We operate across 50+ countries worldwide, offering leading mission-ready capabilities in AI, cloud, cyber and software development. 
 
Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on our career opportunities and events at gdit.com/tc .
